ACL_BASELINE_DATABASE_URL: Postgres URL for the clean baseline used to compare function permissions during ACL recovery.
ACL_TARGET_DATABASE_URL: Postgres URL for the target whose function permissions are compared during ACL recovery.
ACME_EMAIL: Email Caddy sends to the ACME account.
ADSENSE_AUTO_ADS_ENABLED: 기본 false: 검증용 메타태그만 유지하고 Auto Ads 런타임을 시작하지 않음. 승인·동의 설정·페이지 제외를 운영자가 확인한 뒤에만 true로 변경. SPA에서는 스크립트 제거만으로 이전에 실행된 자동 광고가 종료되지 않음.
ALLOWED_ORIGINS: Browser origins allowed to call the ChatGPT integration.
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: Key for the offline meme translation batch.
ANTHROPIC_TRANSLATION_MODEL: Model name for the offline meme translation batch.
AUTH_EMAIL_WEBHOOK: Optional POST target that receives password-reset links.
AUTODEPLOY_CHECK_NAME: CI check-run name that must succeed before the VM deploys a commit. Default check.
AUTODEPLOY_KEEP_IMAGES: How many release and rollback image tags the VM keeps per repository. Default 3.
AUTODEPLOY_PUBLIC_URL: Public origin (through Cloudflare) whose release header confirms a deploy. Default https://catchmeme.com.
AUTODEPLOY_REPO: Public GitHub owner/repo the VM polls anonymously for main and CI state.
AUTODEPLOY_ROOT: Checkout the VM autodeploy builds and deploys from. Default /opt/memecatch.
AUTODEPLOY_SERVER_BUILD_MIN_FREE_MB: Free MB Docker's data directory must have before the VM deploy agent builds the Axum image (MEMECATCH_AXUM=1). Below it the agent refuses to deploy. Default 4000.
AUTODEPLOY_STATE_DIR: Autodeploy state: last deployed SHA, failed and allow markers, lock. Default /var/lib/memecatch-autodeploy.
AUTODEPLOY_STRICT: Force strict mode (non-deploys exit 3, failed SHAs retried) outside SSH, for manual runs.
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: Access key of the memecatch-bedrock IAM user for Bedrock on the OCI VM. Server only.
AWS_REGION: ─── 관리자 자체 밈 초안 생성 (선택, 서버 전용) ──────────────── MPE와 분리된 관리자 house-original 전용 경로입니다. public Studio는 템플릿만 사용합니다.
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: Secret key of the memecatch-bedrock IAM user for Bedrock on the OCI VM. Server only.
AXUM_DB_POOL_MAX: Size of the Axum server's main Postgres pool (docker-compose.axum.yml), default 4. The server can open 2 more for its deadline pool, so 6 by default; Postgres allows 30 in total.
AXUM_DISABLED_ROUTES: Comma-separated ids of Axum native routes to switch off, so the Next app answers them again. Applied on container restart. An id no route has stops the server at startup, with the valid ids in the log.
AXUM_PILOT_ROUTES: Comma-separated ids of the Axum page routes to switch on (page-about, page-meme); a page not named stays Next's, and AXUM_DISABLED_ROUTES still wins. An id that is not a page stops the server at startup. Applied on container restart.
AXUM_URL: Behaviour gate only (server/parity/behaviour): base URL of the local Axum under test, served at the site origin the Next build was given.
BACKUP_AGE_IDENTITY: age identity used to decrypt a backup during restore. Keep it off the backup container.
BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT: age public key that backups are encrypted to before the R2 upload.
BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS: How many days of database dumps to keep in R2.
BEDROCK_MEME_STUDIO_ENABLED: ─── 관리자 자체 밈 초안 생성 (선택, 서버 전용) ──────────────── MPE와 분리된 관리자 house-original 전용 경로입니다. public Studio는 템플릿만 사용합니다.
BEDROCK_MEME_STUDIO_INPUT_NANO_USD_PER_T: nano-USD per input token reserved for an admin meme-studio draft.
BEDROCK_MEME_STUDIO_OUTPUT_NANO_USD_PER_: nano-USD per output token reserved for an admin meme-studio draft.
BEHAVIOUR_CPU_THROTTLE: Behaviour gate only (server/parity/behaviour): a CPU slowdown factor for every page, as in Chromium DevTools, to expose timing defects.
BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: Signs sessions, Kaia challenges, and magic links.
BETTER_AUTH_URL: Public origin Better Auth uses for callbacks.
CHROME_PATH: Optional Chrome binary for Playwright. Defaults to the local Google Chrome path.
CLOUDFLARE_TRUSTED_PROXIES: Space-separated Cloudflare CIDRs so Caddy trusts CF-Connecting-IP.
CRON_SECRET: Bearer token the scheduler sends to cron routes.
CSP_ENFORCE: Set to false to report Content-Security-Policy instead of enforcing it.
CSP_REPORT_URI: Optional URI that receives CSP violation reports.
DATABASE_URL: Postgres URL for the memecatch login role. The app never uses the superuser.
DEPLOY_HOST: Cloudflare Access SSH hostname supplied by the GitHub production environment variable for the deploy job.
DEPLOY_OCI_OWN_CADDY_RUNNING: Test override for whether the site's own Caddy is running.
DEPLOY_OCI_FORCE_RECREATE: Recreate the app container after a manual redeploy, including when the image is cached.
DEPLOY_OCI_PORTS_BUSY: Test override for whether proxy ports are occupied.
DEPLOY_OCI_PRINT_PLAN: Print the OCI deployment plan without executing it.
E2E_BASE_URL: Base URL Playwright uses for end-to-end tests.
EVENT_CALLBACK_ORIGINS: Comma-separated callback origins for the ChatGPT event broker.
EVENT_STATE_KEY_BASE64: Base64 key for the ChatGPT event broker.
EVENT_STATE_PATH: State file path for the ChatGPT event broker.
GA4_PROPERTY_ID: GA4 property id for the operator analytics report.
GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL: GA4 service-account email for the operator analytics report.
GA4_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY: GA4 service-account private key for the operator analytics report.
GITHUB_SHA: GitHub Actions commit SHA requested for deployment; the deploy script requires a full 40-character lowercase SHA.
GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET: GitHub webhook secret checked by the ChatGPT integration.
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: Google OAuth client id. Google login stays closed when empty.
HOME: Login user's home; the deploy-key installer writes ~/.ssh/authorized_keys there.
HOST: Bind address for the optional ChatGPT integration server.
IMPORT_APPROVED: Allows a maintenance import to write approved rows.
INDEXNOW_DISABLED: Set to 1 to stop IndexNow submissions from admin actions (production only; previews never submit).
KAKAO_CLIENT_ID: Kakao OAuth client id. Kakao login stays closed when empty.
LD_LIBRARY_PATH: Shared-library path for the bundled libpq used by the loop-028 safety_reviewed_at proof script.
LOCAL_OBJECT_STORAGE_DIR: Disk directory used when R2 upload credentials are unset.
LOCALIZED_SOFT404_POSTGRES: Set to docker to run the localized soft-404 integration test against an isolated PostgreSQL container.
PARITY_USER: Parity scripts for the Axum server (server/parity/cards-quiz.mjs, tracking.mjs, ops.mjs): one line printed by server/tests/better_auth_cookie.mjs, the session cookie of a throwaway user in the test database. Never set in a deployment.
PARITY_USER_2: Parity scripts for the Axum server (server/parity/cards-quiz.mjs, ops.mjs): the same for a second throwaway user.
TEST_DB_CONTAINER: Name of the throwaway Postgres container that server/scripts/test-db.sh creates and the Axum parity and inventory scripts read through docker exec, default memecatch-axum-test-pg. Never set in a deployment.
WORKER_NODE: Parity script for the Axum server (server/parity/uploads.mjs): the Node binary that runs scripts/mpe-media-worker.mjs against the test database, default the one running the script. Never set in a deployment.
MCP_EVENT_CALLBACK_ORIGINS: Allowed callback origins for ChatGPT integration events.
MCP_EVENT_RETRY_TOKEN: Retry token for ChatGPT integration event delivery.
MCP_EVENT_STATE_KEY: Encryption key for ChatGPT integration event state.
MCP_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET: GitHub webhook secret for the ChatGPT integration.
MCP_OPERATOR_TOKEN: Operator token for the ChatGPT integration.
MEMECATCH_AXUM: Set to 1 to deploy the Axum server in front of Next (docker-compose.axum.yml). Any other value deploys Next alone and removes the next container.
MEMECATCH_BACKUP_DB_PASSWORD: Password of the memecatch_backup login used by pg_dump.
MEMECATCH_CADDY: Set to own to publish memeCatch's Caddy. Any other value uses the shared proxy.
MEMECATCH_DB_PASSWORD: Password of the memecatch Postgres login role.
MEMECATCH_ENV_FILE: Optional path to the OCI deployment environment file.
MEMECATCH_IMAGE: App image tag. Local smoke uses memecatch:local. Production uses GHCR.
MEMECATCH_OPERATOR_USER_ID: Operator user id recorded as reviewer when an origin review script runs with --apply.
MEMECATCH_PREVIEW: Marks the ChatGPT integration as a preview process.
MEMECATCH_QA_ORIGIN: Origin the unified-home QA script opens.
MEMECATCH_RESTORE_CONFIRM: Must be restore before a dump is loaded into the target database.
MEMECATCH_SERVER_IMAGE: Axum server image tag, read only with MEMECATCH_AXUM=1. The deploy agent builds memecatch-server:release-<sha>; compose builds memecatch-server:local when unset.
MEMECATCH_SIGNING_SECRET: HMAC and operator bearer for analytics, view counts, and the embedding probe.
MEMECATCH_WORKER_IMAGE: MPE worker image tag. Built on the VM when unset.
MEME_CHAT_API_KEY: opencodex 선택 시 로컬 loopback 주소만 허용하며 기존 키가 있으면 서버에서만 사용합니다.
MEME_CHAT_BASE_URL: opencodex 선택 시 로컬 loopback 주소만 허용하며 기존 키가 있으면 서버에서만 사용합니다.
MEME_CHAT_GENERATION_ENABLED: 공개 밈 챗봇은 같은 키와 openrouter/free를 사용하며 유료 제공자로 전환하지 않습니다. false로 설정하면 생성 호출 없이 공개 밈 검색 결과와 요약만 제공합니다.
MEME_CHAT_MODEL: opencodex 선택 시 로컬 loopback 주소만 허용하며 기존 키가 있으면 서버에서만 사용합니다.
MEME_CHAT_PROVIDER: 로컬 opencodex를 사용할 때만 선택합니다. 운영(NODE_ENV=production)에서는 무시됩니다.
MEME_EMBEDDING_API_KEY: 변경분 일일 색인: 실제 Linux512토큰 메모리 검증 뒤 true. 기존 CRON_SECRET 사용.
MEME_EMBEDDING_REINDEX_ENABLED: 변경분 일일 색인: 실제 Linux512토큰 메모리 검증 뒤 true. 기존 CRON_SECRET 사용.
MEME_EMBEDDING_RUNTIME: 의미 검색: 고정된 multilingual-e5-small-v1(384차원) corpus와 동일한 모델 서버만 연결합니다. 기본 off. 로컬은 scripts/meme_embeddings.py serve, 운영은 동일 모델의 HTTPS 경로를 씁니다. bundled: 앱 컨테이너 CPU에서 고정 FP32 ONNX 실행. 기존 CRON_SECRET로 요청 서명(새 키 불필요). 빌드 시 모델 검증·포함. MEME_EMBEDDING_URL은 앱 자신의 /v1/embeddings를 가리킵니다.
MEME_EMBEDDING_URL: 변경분 일일 색인: 실제 Linux512토큰 메모리 검증 뒤 true. 기존 CRON_SECRET 사용.
MEME_SEMANTIC_SEARCH_ENABLED: bundled를 배포할 때만 1. 외부 모델 서버·기본 off에는 필요 없습니다.
META_GRAPH_API_VERSION: Instagram 공개 발견은 Facebook Login 기반 Professional 계정의 Hashtag Search만 사용합니다. 최대 30개 해시태그/rolling 7일. 원본 이미지·영상 파일과 media_url은 저장하지 않습니다.
META_INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN: Instagram 공개 발견은 Facebook Login 기반 Professional 계정의 Hashtag Search만 사용합니다. 최대 30개 해시태그/rolling 7일. 원본 이미지·영상 파일과 media_url은 저장하지 않습니다.
META_INSTAGRAM_USER_ID: Instagram 공개 발견은 Facebook Login 기반 Professional 계정의 Hashtag Search만 사용합니다. 최대 30개 해시태그/rolling 7일. 원본 이미지·영상 파일과 media_url은 저장하지 않습니다.
MPE_FFMPEG_TIMEOUT_MS: ffmpeg timeout inside the media worker.
MPE_FFPROBE_TIMEOUT_MS: ffprobe timeout inside the media worker.
MPE_WORKER_MAX_IDLE_POLL_MS: MPE worker: 빈 큐는 2초→4초→8초→…→30초 간격, 작업 처리 후 2초로 복귀. 고정 간격이 필요하면 두 값을 동일하게 지정. 실행 중 worker는 재시작 후 적용.
MPE_WORKER_POLL_MS: MPE worker: 빈 큐는 2초→4초→8초→…→30초 간격, 작업 처리 후 2초로 복귀. 고정 간격이 필요하면 두 값을 동일하게 지정. 실행 중 worker는 재시작 후 적용.
NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSENSE_CLIENT: AdSense 게시자 ID (ca-pub-…) — 계정 소유권 확인 메타태그에 사용 (ads.txt는 public/ads.txt 정적 파일로 별도 관리)
NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID: ─── 분석·수익화 (선택 — 비우면 해당 기능 비활성) ───────────────── GA4 측정 ID (G-…) — 설정 시 gtag 자동 로드 (@next/third-parties)
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: ─── 사이트 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── canonical·OG·sitemap·llms.txt의 절대 URL 기준 (프로덕션: https://catchmeme.com)
NEXT_URL: Behaviour gate only (server/parity/behaviour): base URL of the local Next under test, at an origin it trusts (http://localhost:<port>).
NODE_ENV: Node runtime mode. Production images set production.
OBJECT_SIGNING_SECRET: HMAC secret for short-lived object URLs. Falls back to BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.
OPENAI_API_KEY: ─── 관리자 AI 검수 (선택) ───────────────────────────────────── 관리자 검수 화면의 밈 설명 초안은 서버 전용 GPT-5.6 Sol high를 사용합니다.
OPENAI_REVIEW_BASE_URL: 관리자 검수 모델은 gpt-5.6-sol로 고정되며 reasoning effort는 high입니다. 기본값: https://api.openai.com/v1. 비워 두면 기본 OpenAI API를 사용합니다.
OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ─── MPE 미디어 처리 (서버·worker 전용) ───────────────────────── OpenRouter에서 발급한 키만 사용합니다. OPENAI_API_KEY와 혼용하지 않습니다. 앱 컨테이너와 MPE worker 양쪽에 동일하게 주입하되 클라이언트에는 노출하지 않습니다.
OPENROUTER_BASE_URL: opencodex 선택 시 로컬 loopback 주소만 허용하며 기존 키가 있으면 서버에서만 사용합니다.
OPENROUTER_MPE_MODEL: OCR·근거 초안. 이 값은 stealth/ox-alpha로 고정되며 다른 값은 런타임에서 거부됩니다.
PGDATA: Local Postgres data directory used by the loop-028 safety_reviewed_at proof script.
PGDATABASE: Target database name exported by the backup tools from the postgres URL.
PGHOST: Local Postgres socket or host used by the loop-028 safety_reviewed_at proof script.
PGPASSFILE: Path to the mode-0600 pgpass file used by the backup and restore tools.
PGPORT: Local Postgres port used by the loop-028 safety_reviewed_at proof script.
PLUS_DIGEST_DELIVERY_TOKEN: Bearer token for Plus digest, expiry, and saved-meme email delivery. Server only.
PLUS_DIGEST_DELIVERY_URL: HTTPS endpoint that receives Plus digest, expiry, and saved-meme emails. Server only.
PLUS_DIGEST_FROM_EMAIL: From address for Plus digest, expiry, and saved-meme emails. Server only.
PORT: HTTP port. The app container listens on 3000.
POSTGRES_DB: Database name created by the Postgres image. Always memecatch.
POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Password of the Postgres superuser used for init and administration.
POSTGRES_USER: Superuser name the Postgres image creates. The app does not connect as this user.
R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ─── Cloudflare R2 (선택 — 제보 이미지 저장소) ──────────────────── 전부 서버 전용(lib/r2.server.ts). 4종이 비면 LOCAL_OBJECT_STORAGE_DIR 로컬 저장소로 폴백. 대시보드 → R2 → API 토큰(Object Read & Write, 버킷 한정)에서 발급
R2_ACCOUNT_ID: ─── Cloudflare R2 (선택 — 제보 이미지 저장소) ──────────────────── 전부 서버 전용(lib/r2.server.ts). 4종이 비면 LOCAL_OBJECT_STORAGE_DIR 로컬 저장소로 폴백. 대시보드 → R2 → API 토큰(Object Read & Write, 버킷 한정)에서 발급
R2_BACKUP_BUCKET: R2 bucket that stores compressed pg_dump files.
R2_BUCKET: ─── Cloudflare R2 (선택 — 제보 이미지 저장소) ──────────────────── 전부 서버 전용(lib/r2.server.ts). 4종이 비면 LOCAL_OBJECT_STORAGE_DIR 로컬 저장소로 폴백. 대시보드 → R2 → API 토큰(Object Read & Write, 버킷 한정)에서 발급
R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ─── Cloudflare R2 (선택 — 제보 이미지 저장소) ──────────────────── 전부 서버 전용(lib/r2.server.ts). 4종이 비면 LOCAL_OBJECT_STORAGE_DIR 로컬 저장소로 폴백. 대시보드 → R2 → API 토큰(Object Read & Write, 버킷 한정)에서 발급
RADAR_INSTAGRAM_HASHTAGS: Instagram 공개 발견은 Facebook Login 기반 Professional 계정의 Hashtag Search만 사용합니다. 최대 30개 해시태그/rolling 7일. 원본 이미지·영상 파일과 media_url은 저장하지 않습니다.
RADAR_THREADS_TERMS: Threads keyword_search 승인 전에는 인증 사용자 소유 게시물만 검색됩니다.
RADAR_X_TERMS: ─── Radar 외부 신호 (선택, 전부 서버 전용) ────────────────────── X·Threads는 텍스트 게시물만 요청하고 미디어는 무시합니다. X API는 pay-per-use이므로 RADAR_X_TERMS를 작게 유지하고 콘솔 spending limit을 설정하세요.
RELEASE_SHA: Build revision shown in diagnostics and CSP reports.
RUNNER_TEMP: GitHub Actions runner temporary directory holding the deploy SSH key and known_hosts files.
SITE_ADDRESS: Caddy site address. catchmeme.com in production.
SOURCE_DISCOVERY_OUTPUT_DIR: Optional output directory for daily source-discovery logs; defaults to output/source-discovery.
SSH_CONNECTION: Set by sshd. The deploy agent runs strict when GitHub Actions calls it over SSH.
SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND: Set by sshd for the forced-command deploy key; carries the commit SHA GitHub asks to deploy.
STUB_CA: Parity script server/parity/ops.mjs: the CA certificate of the local HTTPS stub (server/parity/https-stub.mjs) that stands in for the email provider. Never set in a deployment.
THREADS_ACCESS_TOKEN: Threads keyword_search 승인 전에는 인증 사용자 소유 게시물만 검색됩니다.
TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY: ─── TikTok Login Kit (선택) ──────────────────────────────────── TikTok Developer Portal의 Login Kit 승인 후 서버 환경에만 설정합니다.
TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET: ─── TikTok Login Kit (선택) ──────────────────────────────────── TikTok Developer Portal의 Login Kit 승인 후 서버 환경에만 설정합니다.
TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI: ─── TikTok Login Kit (선택) ──────────────────────────────────── TikTok Developer Portal의 Login Kit 승인 후 서버 환경에만 설정합니다.
TMPDIR: Override for temporary files created by maintenance scripts.
X_API_BEARER_TOKEN: ─── Radar 외부 신호 (선택, 전부 서버 전용) ────────────────────── X·Threads는 텍스트 게시물만 요청하고 미디어는 무시합니다. X API는 pay-per-use이므로 RADAR_X_TERMS를 작게 유지하고 콘솔 spending limit을 설정하세요.
YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ─── YouTube Data API (선택) ───────────────────────────────────── 출처 후보 발견·메타데이터 재확인용. 서버 전용 (클라이언트 노출 금지). 영상 파일은 저장하지 않고 메타데이터만 조회합니다.
